CallNYC was an independent follow-on project built after the complete CouncilStat release. Politico New York covered it in 2016 as a website for exploring City Council constituent-services data. It was not an official Council product or a documented formal hackathon submission.

District offices used CouncilStat differently and entered information with different frequency. Recorded case counts could reflect demand, outreach, staffing, or data-entry practices; they should not be read as a simple performance ranking.
